voiceScript: A friendly player can still be a stranger asking your child for too much. Family Online Gaming Safety means the risks created when games connect children with strangers through voice chat, messages, trades, purchases, and public profiles. Picture this: a friendly player asks a child to move to private chat, share a real name, and buy an item through an outside link. Here is why that matters: the pressure can lead to scams, unwanted purchases, bullying, or exposed family details. Block private messages from strangers and keep chat age-appropriate. Use purchase limits and tell an adult when a player creates pressure. Click the Follow button to see new cybersecurity tips every day.
